properties.name: easygram.i18n.enabled
properties.description: Whether to activate Easygram i18n support. When true, BotI18nAutoConfiguration registers: BotMessageSource, BotKeyboardFactory, BotLocaleResolver, BotLocaleSetterFilter, BotLocaleArgumentResolver, locale-aware BotReplyButtonMatcher, locale-aware BotInlineQueryMatcher, and BotLocalizedReplyReturnTypeHandler. Also requires spring.messages.basename to point to your message bundle files. Defaults to false — bots that do not use message bundles are unaffected even when core-i18n is on the classpath.

properties.name: easygram.i18n.default-locale
properties.description: Fallback locale for users whose Telegram language code is absent or unrecognised. Use IETF BCP 47 language tags (e.g. 'en', 'ru', 'uz').

values.description: Activate locale-aware matchers, BotMessageSource, and BotKeyboardFactory. Requires spring.messages.basename.
Skip all i18n beans. Plain-text matchers from core are used for @BotReplyButton and @BotInlineQuery routing.
